create.name: James Cole
create.bio:
James Cole is the meditation guide and writer behind Empowering Meditations, a library of long, story-led guided meditations that take the listener on journeys through a forest, a river, a cabin, a library of wisdom. He first learned to meditate from a teacher while still at high school, kept it up as a daily habit, and was experimenting with deep trance states before he left his teens. His curiosity carried him into language, psychology, consciousness and spirituality.

He worked in film for some years before training in neuro-linguistic programming, hypnosis, life coaching and Matrix Therapies, and he draws on that background when he scripts a meditation, taking care over the images, wording and suggestions in each recording. He describes Empowering Meditations as one of his creative projects; he also writes and records music under the name Seven Shades of Nothing.

Alongside the recordings, which he shares on his website and YouTube channel, he offers a free self-paced audio course in deep relaxation meditation that starts from the problem of a busy mind, and a free ebook that takes apart sixteen common beliefs about how meditation is supposed to be done. His 2019 book, Empowering Thoughts, gathers short reflections on letting go, inner peace and the nature of reality around the story of a child who learns from an empowered master.

books.title: Empowering Thoughts
books.author: James Cole
books.description: A 282-page collection of short reflections and philosophy on letting go, making peace with yourself and questioning reality, framed by the story of a child learning from an empowered master. Meant to be read a little at a time.

free_resources.title: Deep Relaxation Meditation Program
free_resources.description: A free self-paced audio course for beginners: lessons on what meditation is, resting attention on the breath, a first visualisation exercise, handling distractions and building a regular habit, with guided recordings including versions for sleep. Access by email sign-up.

free_resources.title: 16 Myths of Meditation
free_resources.description: A free 19-page PDF that looks at sixteen ideas that put people off meditating, such as needing an empty mind, a special posture or hours each day. Sent by email after sign-up.
